scope: Read-only schema and provenance review of the two Phase 15 Boltz affinity drafts; no model execution, weight download, cloud work or mutation of frozen inputs.

official_sources.finding: The latest official upstream release identified is Boltz v2.2.1 (tag commit cb04aec). PyPI also lists boltz 2.2.1. Pin this exact version/commit and checkpoint hashes for reproducibility; do not use an unpinned main-branch install.

The current official schema accepts version, sequences with protein sequence/msa and ligand smiles, templates with cif/chain_id/template_id, and properties affinity binder. The drafts use this shape. Official docs explicitly allow msa: empty for single-sequence mode, but describe it as lower accuracy; without msa: empty or --use_msa_server, a precomputed MSA is required.
official_sources.endpoint_semantics: affinity_pred_value is log10(IC50 in µM), where lower values indicate stronger predicted binding; affinity_probability_binary is a separate binder-versus-decoy probability. For comparison to pIC50 in nM, use pIC50 = 6 - affinity_pred_value.

official_sources.finding: The official affinity example confirms a single protein/ligand sequence pair and properties affinity binder pointing to the ligand chain ID. Both drafts use binder L and a unique ligand ID L, so their affinity-property linkage is schema-consistent.

inputs.role: 6ED6 structure-linked known-bound ligand; measured ROCK2 IC50 37 nM
inputs.schema_status: Shape matches official affinity YAML schema.
inputs.template_mapping: protein chain A -> 6ED6 CIF template chain A
risks: One in-series known ligand cannot establish affinity calibration or generalisation.

inputs.role: measured right-censored weak ROCK2 control; IC50 >10000 nM
inputs.schema_status: Shape matches official affinity YAML schema.
inputs.template_mapping: protein chain A -> 6ED6 CIF template chain A
risks: The censored value is a weak-control bound, not an exact numeric target for regression.
Boltz affinity_pred_value is documented for comparing binders and should not be treated as a calibrated inactive/nonbinder score.

template_and_sequence.rcsb_record: 6ED6 reports human ROCK2, chains A/B, 415-residue polymer and 2.86 Å X-ray structure.
template_and_sequence.assessment: The explicit A-to-A mapping is plausible and consistent with the RCSB entry, but the parser must be run before inference to catch sequence/template alignment or residue-numbering issues. Preserve the construct/assay mismatch already documented in the ROCK review.

hardware_and_run_caveats: Boltz official docs default to GPU and state CPU is significantly slower; use a pinned CUDA-compatible environment for a bounded run and record GPU, driver, CUDA, PyTorch, Boltz and checkpoint versions.
The two inputs are smoke-test drafts only. Validate YAML through the pinned Boltz parser before downloading weights or running inference; no parser is installed in the current local .venv.
Set an explicit cache/output directory inside approved research storage and hash all downloaded checkpoints. Avoid implicit ~/.boltz caches for provenance.

Keep msa: empty only as the declared single-sequence smoke-test condition. A validation run should use a reproducible precomputed MSA or explicitly record use of the official MSA server and its date/result hash.
Relative template paths should be resolved from a fixed repository working directory or converted to verified absolute paths; do not rely on an undocumented invocation CWD.

scientific_interpretation.comparison: The known 37 nM compound and >10 µM censored weak control can check execution and whether outputs are directionally separated, but two points cannot test rank correlation, MAE, calibration or applicability.
scientific_interpretation.target_endpoint: Boltz predicts a learned binding-affinity surrogate documented as log10(IC50 in µM), while the source assay is a specific GST-fused recombinant ROCK2 HTRF/33P-ATP inhibition assay. Compare only after preserving assay metadata and conversion; do not call the output Kd or cellular efficacy.
scientific_interpretation.leakage: The known-bound ligand is necessarily structure-selected and from the same medicinal chemistry source series as the affinity record. It must remain an anchor/smoke test, not an independent test point; future evaluation needs publication/series-held-out measured ligands.
scientific_interpretation.cept: Neither input tests CEPT. CEPT is a biological mixture; its cell-recovery effects cannot be inferred from one ROCK2 affinity anchor and one censored enzyme control.

decision: Both drafts are structurally valid against the current official schema and have a plausible 415-residue ROCK2 chain-A template mapping. Proceed only as a pinned, parser-validated smoke test. Interpret affinity_pred_value using the documented log10(IC50 in µM) semantics; the two-control result cannot establish model performance, novelty, ROCK2 assay calibration, or CEPT efficacy.
